pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with jagged but soft-edged pixel gradients. The geometry ranges from quadrilateral to hexagonal with darker interiors and slightly lighter, textured perimeters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-tan corridors. Junction nodes are predominantly three-way and four-way intersections with varying pixel width, generally narrower than the patches they separate.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, erect mane along the neck-to-shoulder transition. The silhouette shows a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated edge against the background sky.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion of the lower flank and hindquarters by out-of-focus, grey-brown foreground vegetation.
